{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Z6RotaryBlasterCannon-SWE.png|thumb|right|250px|A Z-6 heavy rotary cannon]]
A '''heavy weapon''' was a personal weapon which required more than one crew member, often utilizing extra equipment such as [[Tripod (weapon attachment)/Legends|tripod]] mounts and portable [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]]. Heavy weapons were also known as '''infantry support weapons''' and '''light artillery pieces'''. Most heavy weapons were designed to be used by [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] and were easily transportable, with examples like the [[T-21 light repeating blaster/Legends|T-21 light repeating blaster]] being able to be carried by a single [[Soldier/Legends|trooper]]. Some weapons were large enough to be mounted on [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] trailers for mobility.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Typically, a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of soldiers were issued with at least one heavy weapon, such as a [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]]. Heavy weapons also included vehicle mounted weaponry, such as [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]], mounted repeating blasters, [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]], and [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launchers]].<ref name="EGWT" />
